data.title: kadence ui notices journal changes by fs.watch with a one-second poll behind it
data.why: fs.watch alone misses a month directory created after the watch began, and is unreliable on network drives and some Linux setups; a poll alone is up to a second late on every change. Together: immediate where the watch works, a second late where it does not, and the poll costs a handful of readdir/stat calls on the events directory, never a fold
data.rejected: fs.watch only: silently stops seeing work when the first event of a new month creates its directory; poll only: every change a second late, where the watch is instant; a long-running daemon or socket between processes: a server, which kadence does not have by design
